## [Click here to watch the video](https://youtu.be/WaseymlIgFw?si=E8t1L7qhefQ-0CsJ)


### **“That’s not a job I stepped into. It’s the place my entire career led me.” Starfighters Space CEO Tim Franta on the origin of the world’s largest commercial supersonic fleet.**


**About CEO Tim Franta**
Tim Franta was appointed Chief Executive Officer of Starfighters Space, Inc. on February 23, 2026. He joined the Company in October 2022 as Vice President of Development, leading development of the STARLAUNCH air-launch system. Prior to Starfighters, he served as Deputy Director of Energy Florida in Cape Canaveral (2018–2022) and Director of Special Projects (2012–2018), focused on space and energy business development and aligning public policy with private and government financing. Earlier in his career he worked for the Florida Legislature and served as Chief of Staff for the Florida Space Authority, where he helped draft space transportation legislation for the state.


**About Starfighters Space, Inc. (NYSE American: FJET)**
Starfighters Space, Inc. is the only commercial company in the world with the ability to fly payloads at sustained MACH 2+ and with the capability to launch those payloads to space. The Company operates a fleet of F-104 Starfighter aircraft from NASA’s Kennedy Space Center, supporting hypersonic testing, flight research, pilot training, and the development of its STARLAUNCH air-launch platform.
